integrity: Independent audit has not been performed. The analytical proof covers all specified rim sizes and rates; the supplied program performs finitely many exact arithmetic checks and numerical asymptotics, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite wheel graphs with strictly positive homogeneous rim and spoke Poisson rates and irreversible edge-dimer occupation; one-site jammed probability and fixed-rate large-rim asymptotics only. The zero spoke-rate limit is singular. The original 1989 journal work was not fully accessible, so bibliographic priority is provisional.
title: A universal leading amplitude for the hub-survival probability in weighted wheel dimer adsorption
